title: Customer Segmentation and Value Tiers
problem_statement: A wholesale distributor needs an exploratory segmentation of customer spending and order intensity to design service hypotheses without assuming clusters are permanent truths.
questions: Which spending and frequency profiles emerge?
How should service hypotheses differ by profile?
hypotheses: Spending and order frequency form distinct profiles.
Channel mix explains part of segment differences.
recommendations: Stress-test cluster count and initialization before labeling segments.
Use clusters to generate service hypotheses, then validate with customer outcomes.
